identity_anchor: The specific geometric arrangement of the two interlocking 'M' peaks (white chevron shapes).
brand_cues_to_preserve: The exact vector path of the double-peak 'M' logo
The overlapping intersection point between the left and right peaks
The rounded corners of the stroke ends
semantic_cues_to_preserve: Upward pointing peaks implying connection and signal transmission
Symmetrical balance representing stability in communication
structure_policy_rationale: Following the pattern of Alipay and Douyin, the core logo geometry must be strictly preserved to ensure instant recognition. The transformation is purely material (flat vector to 3D ice) and dimensional (adding thickness), without altering the silhouette or spatial relationship of the peaks.
design_rationale: Tencent Meeting's identity relies entirely on its unique abstract 'M' shape. To fit the 'Ice Theme', this shape is extruded into a solid block of ice. The overlapping area of the original logo provides a perfect opportunity to showcase the theme's subsurface scattering and refraction properties, making the intersection look like fused ice crystals.
must_preserve: The precise angle of the chevrons
The relative size and position of the two intersecting parts
can_recompose: The flat white fill becomes translucent ice blue volume
The background gradient is removed for pure white
Internal details are replaced by frozen bubbles and snowflake textures
forbid: Changing the logo to a literal camera or microphone icon
Using the original dark blue brand color
Creating a flat 2D blue shape without 3D volume
Sharp, jagged edges (must be smooth and rounded like melted ice)
generation_direction: Generate a 3D ice sculpture of the Tencent Meeting logo (two interlocking white peaks forming an M). Material is translucent pale cyan ice with internal bubbles and snowflake textures. Surface is glossy with condensation droplets. Rounded edges, soft refraction. Centered on a clean white background with a subtle contact shadow and melting water puddle at the base.
